description: Real mainnet transactions used as provenance specimens. Every signature and account here is public on-chain data and can be checked on any Solana explorer. This manifest records what each transaction is and the key facts a correct decode must reproduce; it does not contain the raw transactions. Use tools/fetch_specimens.py with your own RPC endpoint to materialize the raw getTransaction responses into specimens/raw/, after which tests/test_specimens.py runs the verifier against them.
provenance: Signatures, expected verdicts, and the recorded evidence below were taken from a prior offline decode of these transactions (logs/genuine_grad_fixture_decisions.json in the source research project). The recorded evidence is what that earlier decode observed on chain; the fetch tool and test re-derive the same facts from the freshly fetched transaction and compare, so a wrong or truncated fetch is caught.
note_on_outcome: These transactions were classified genuine/not-genuine by the earlier decode. Whether THIS repository's stricter, account-bound verifier reproduces that classification is exactly what the specimen test measures. A genuine specimen that this verifier rejects would be a real finding about the verifier's strictness, not a defect in the specimen.

recorded_evidence.note: The earlier decode found the pump.fun and PumpSwap programs present but no matching LP mint-and-burn, so provenance was not established. This is the discriminating negative: a transaction that clears the program checks but fails the LP-destruction requirement.
